raw_text: Renewed Wagner Group activity detected in eastern Libya's oil crescent region. Local sources report approximately 200 Russian-speaking fighters arrived at positions near Es Sider and Ras Lanuf oil terminals since mid-September. The deployment follows the dissolution of Wagner's independent command structure after Prigozhin's death in August. Libya's Petroleum Facilities Guard has not commented on the presence.
